rem Combined Volume of Cuboids
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=212
rem Cuboid n has its corner (x, y, z)
rem and sides (dx, dy, dz) from six
rem terms of the lagged Fibonacci
rem sequence S. Find the volume of the
rem union of the first N cuboids.

use numbers
use io
use cli

option N integer = 50000

rem S(k) = 100003 - 200003 k + 300007
rem k^3 for k up to 55 and S(k) = S(k -
rem 24) + S(k - 55) after, all mod 10^6.
rem Cuboid n takes S(6 n - 5) to S(6 n):
rem x, y, z mod 10000 and 1 + the others
rem mod 399. The union is cut in slabs
rem of one unit in x, each the area of
rem the union of the active (y, z)
rem rectangles. This is found by
rem sweeping in y over unit strips, the
rem open and close of each rectangle at
rem its y, with a segment tree on z of
rem cover counts and covered lengths,
rem updated from the bottom.
Sq = array shape (6 * N + 1) fill 0
for K in 1 to (6 * N)
  if K at most 55
    Cu = K * K * K
    Lf = 100003 - 200003 * K
    Lf += 300007 * Cu
    Sq K = Lf mod 1000000
  else
    Sa = Sq (K - 24)
    Sb = Sq (K - 55)
    Sq K = (Sa + Sb) mod 1000000
  end
end
Cx = array shape N fill 0
Cy = array shape N fill 0
Cz = array shape N fill 0
Dx = array shape N fill 0
Dy = array shape N fill 0
Dz = array shape N fill 0
for I in 0 till N
  Cx I = Sq (6 * I + 1) mod 10000
  Cy I = Sq (6 * I + 2) mod 10000
  Cz I = Sq (6 * I + 3) mod 10000
  Dx I = 1 + Sq (6 * I + 4) mod 399
  Dy I = 1 + Sq (6 * I + 5) mod 399
  Dz I = 1 + Sq (6 * I + 6) mod 399
end
Xm = 10400
Hs = array shape (Xm + 1) fill 0 - 1
Sn = array shape N fill 0 - 1
for I in 0 till N
  Sn I = Hs (Cx I)
  Hs (Cx I) = I
end
Nz = 16384
Cn = array shape (2 * Nz) fill 0
Ln = array shape (2 * Nz) fill 0
Sz = array shape (2 * Nz) fill 1
for I in 1 to (Nz - 1)
  Hc = Nz - I
  L2 = 2 * Hc
  Sz Hc = Sz L2 + Sz (L2 + 1)
end
Al = array shape N fill 0
Na = 0
Hy = array shape (Xm + 1) fill 0 - 1
En = array shape (2 * N) fill 0 - 1
Ev = array shape (2 * N) fill 0
Total = 0
for X in 0 to (Xm - 1)
  Kp = 0
  for T in 0 till Na
    I = Al T
    if Cx I + Dx I greater X
      Al Kp = I
      Kp += 1
    end
  end
  Na = Kp
  Ci = Hs X
  for
    if Ci less 0
      break
    end
    Al Na = Ci
    Na += 1
    Ci = Sn Ci
  end
  if Na equal 0
    continue
  end
  for T in 0 till Na
    I = Al T
    E1 = 2 * T
    E2 = 2 * T + 1
    En E1 = Hy (Cy I)
    Hy (Cy I) = E1
    En E2 = Hy (Cy I + Dy I)
    Hy (Cy I + Dy I) = E2
  end
  Area = 0
  for Y in 0 to (Xm - 1)
    Ce = Hy Y
    for
      if Ce less 0
        break
      end
      T = Ce // 2
      I = Al T
      V = 1
      if Ce mod 2 equal 1
        V = 0 - 1
      end
      L = Cz I + Nz
      R = Cz I + Dz I + Nz
      L0 = L
      R0 = R - 1
      for
        if L at least R
          break
        end
        if L mod 2 equal 1
          Cn L += V
          if Cn L greater 0
            Ln L = Sz L
          else
            if L at least Nz
              Ln L = 0
            else
              Ch = 2 * L
              Ln L = Ln Ch + Ln (Ch + 1)
            end
          end
          L += 1
        end
        if R mod 2 equal 1
          R -= 1
          Cn R += V
          if Cn R greater 0
            Ln R = Sz R
          else
            if R at least Nz
              Ln R = 0
            else
              Ch = 2 * R
              Ln R = Ln Ch + Ln (Ch + 1)
            end
          end
        end
        L = L // 2
        R = R // 2
      end
      P = L0 // 2
      for
        if P equal 0
          break
        end
        if Cn P greater 0
          Ln P = Sz P
        else
          Ch = 2 * P
          Ln P = Ln Ch + Ln (Ch + 1)
        end
        P = P // 2
      end
      P = R0 // 2
      for
        if P equal 0
          break
        end
        if Cn P greater 0
          Ln P = Sz P
        else
          Ch = 2 * P
          Ln P = Ln Ch + Ln (Ch + 1)
        end
        P = P // 2
      end
      Ce = En Ce
    end
    Area += Ln 1
  end
  for T in 0 till Na
    I = Al T
    Hy (Cy I) = 0 - 1
    Hy (Cy I + Dy I) = 0 - 1
  end
  Total += Area
end
Answer = Total
Answer print
